items.title: Bortoleto confident of 'fighting for points' in Italy
items.content: Gabriel Bortoleto believes Audi "can be fighting for points" in the Italian Grand Prix, having just missed out on reaching the top 10 in Qualifying by the smallest of margins.

summaries.en: Gabriel Bortoleto expresses confidence that Audi can compete for points in the Italian Grand Prix, despite narrowly missing the top 10 in qualifying by a small margin.

items.content: George Russell was unexpectedly pipped to pole position for the Italian Grand Prix by Alpine’s Pierre Gasly.

summaries.en: George Russell lost pole position at the Italian Grand Prix to Alpine's Pierre Gasly. Gasly was described as "flying," suggesting a strong performance. The article focuses on Russell's prospects following the unexpected result.

items.title: Ferrari drivers critical of Italy Qualifying strategy
items.content: Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton admit that Ferrari failed to execute a good enough strategy during Qualifying for the Italian Grand Prix, with the pair only achieving P4 and P5 respectively.

summaries.en: Ferrari drivers Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton criticized the team's qualifying strategy for the Italian Grand Prix. They stated that Ferrari failed to execute a strong enough plan, resulting in their positions of fourth and fifth. The summary highlights their dissatisfaction with the team's performance during qualifying.

items.title: Piastri hit with three-place grid penalty at Monza
items.content: Oscar Piastri has been handed a three-place grid penalty for the Italian Grand Prix after the stewards found him guilty of impeding Liam Lawson in Qualifying.
